svg.title: Decision tree roadmap
svg.desc: Seven stages from loading data to reading the fitted tree, with the variable passed between each stage, the target y skipping encoding, the test rows held back until scoring, an optional regression baseline, and a panel showing how .fit() grows the tree one split at a time.
svg.text: Decision tree roadmap: how the code blocks connect
Each box is a stage in the code. The label on each arrow is the variable handed to the next stage.
